description: This file defines a SettingsController class for managing user settings related to chat functionality in a Flutter application. It handles loading and saving the chat enabled preference using shared preferences and notifies listeners of state changes.

classes.name: SettingsController
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages the chat enabled setting, allowing it to be loaded from and saved to persistent storage, and notifying listeners upon changes.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the chat enabled setting from shared preferences and marks the controller as loaded.

methods.name: setChatEnabled
methods.description: Sets the chat enabled setting to the specified value, persists it, and notifies listeners.
